informationWeCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.content: We collect information you submit through our contact form: name, email, phone, company, service selection, and your message. Your submission is sent via EmailJS to our business inbox.

howWeUseInformation.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
howWeUseInformation.content: We use this information to respond to your inquiry, provide service details, and follow up about potential work. We do not use it for marketing without your explicit consent.

informationSharing.title: 3. Information Sharing
informationSharing.content: We do not sell or rent your data. EmailJS acts as our processor to deliver your message. We do not share your information with other third parties.

dataSecurity.title: 4. Data Security
dataSecurity.content: Submissions are transmitted over HTTPS. We retain messages only as long as needed to respond and maintain basic business records.
